===Pokémon===
Like the player, he uses [[rental Pokémon]]. The rental Pokémon that Noland uses are the same as those of another Trainer fought within the round in which he appears, but with fixed IVs of 15 and 31 for the Silver and Gold Symbol fights, respectively.

Noland uses three Pokémon from this list:
:[[List of Battle Frontier Pokémon in Generation III]]
* If Noland appears as the 21st battle of a Lv. 50 streak, his Pokémon are selected from the second listed variant of the species from {{DL|List of Battle Frontier Pokémon in Generation III|Group 2}}.
* If Noland appears as the 42nd battle of a Lv. 50 streak or as the 21st battle of an Open Level streak, his Pokémon are selected from the third listed variant of the species from {{DL|List of Battle Frontier Pokémon in Generation III|Group 3}}. However, Noland will not use {{p|Dragonite}}, {{p|Tyranitar}}, or any [[Legendary Pokémon]].
* If Noland appears as the 63rd or later battle of a Lv. 50 streak, his Pokémon are selected from {{DL|List of Battle Frontier Pokémon in Generation III|Group 3}}. However, Noland will not use {{p|Dragonite}}, {{p|Tyranitar}}, or the last two variants of {{p|Articuno}}, {{p|Zapdos}}, {{p|Moltres}}, {{p|Raikou}}, {{p|Entei}}, or {{p|Suicune}}, as these Pokémon do not appear at Lv. 50.
* If Noland appears as the 42nd or later battle of an Open Level streak, his Pokémon are selected from {{DL|List of Battle Frontier Pokémon in Generation III|Group 3}}.
